answer: Re-attestations are stored in summit and ivory lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the river graph. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 16 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 3779 identities would post 2125 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
